name: codex-binder-lane
description: Plan and design binders in Codex: pick target sites, tools and comp bio budget, then get your structures and sequences.

interface.longDescription: Give Codex a target and your constraints. Codex can choose the structure, site, tools, routes, and campaign size; run and compare parallel lanes; filter and iterate on candidates; and return sequences, target–binder structures, metrics, visuals, video, and a report.
defaultPrompt: Plan a binder campaign for this protein goal. Choose the structure, target site, tools, candidate count, and budget.
Compare two binder-design workflows side by side, score them consistently, and promote the strongest candidates.
Run another design round from these finalists, filter by my metrics, and return sequences, structures, visuals, and costs.
